title: Curry Potato Tacos
description: A delicious twist on traditional tacos, with a flavorful curry-spiced potato filling. Serve with your favorite toppings.
instructions: 1. Peel the potatoes and chop them into small pieces.
2. Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
3. Add the curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
4. Add the potatoes to the pan and stir to coat with curry powder.
5. Cook for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the potatoes are tender.
6. Stir in the curry and season with salt to taste.
7. Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
8. Assemble the tacos by spooning the potato filling onto a tortilla and topping with cilantro, sour cream, cheese, and/or salsa.
10. Garnish with additional cilantro and serve with your favorite toppings.
